title: UMBRELLA: Release 2.1 readiness: ComfyUI 0.39.0 + the 3D Scene ungated, MPI-1043 leftovers block the cut
description: Umbrella for the 2.1 release - named 2.0.2 until Fabio renamed it on 2026-10-10 ("we might as well call it 2.1, so there's no problem in having the dev gate removed"). 2.1 ships the engine bump to ComfyUI 0.39.0 (MPI-1043), Qwen-Image 2.1 (MPI-1064) and the 3D Scene with its 360 Pano Flow UNGATED (MPI-623). BLOCKERS, all must close before the cut: (1) scoped smoke of Qwen-Image 2.1 (MPI-936) + 3D scene (MPI-623) with --flows all on the v0.25.0-dev Pod image, once both graphs land; price and run count to Fabio first. (2) sync mpi-ci cubric-vision-pod/node_lock.json MpiNodes to the app pin (code-only, no rebuild). (3) clean RELEASE Pod image rebuild at v0.25.0 and move the STABLE POD_IMAGE_VERSION / _CPU pair in routes/remotePodLifecycle.js; mandatory after an engine bump, or 2.1 users get a 0.39.0 local engine against a 0.34.0 Pod. (4) MPI-623 dev_mode gates off (its plan Phase 4). (5) stamp 2.1 with /mpi-version-bump, then /mpi-release. Details in brief.md.
